blockers.title: No privacy or legal review for employee location data
blockers.why: The app "records GPS location and time" for reps and stores "Check-in history ... for 3 years", yet no privacy, legal, consent or employee-monitoring review is listed, which could force changes to what is built or where it can launch.
blockers.fix: Add a legal/privacy review item with an owner and date, and requirements for rep consent/disclosure, OS permission prompts, data access controls and a justified retention period.

blockers.title: Offline check-in behavior is undefined
blockers.why: "Offline check-ins" is an open question, but field reps often lack connectivity and the answer (queue-and-sync vs. block) changes the mobile architecture and verification logic for R1/R2.
blockers.fix: Resolve the question with Leo before eng starts and add a requirement with acceptance criteria for offline capture, sync timing and how delayed check-ins are verified.

blockers.title: Rollout has no ramp or rollback trigger
blockers.why: "Two design-partner customers, then all field-sales accounts" jumps straight to everyone, and the rollback plan has no condition for when to use it.
blockers.fix: Add an internal stage and percentage ramp, define rollback triggers (e.g., battery complaints or verification error rates above a threshold), and name a monitoring owner.

improvements: Success metrics: the guardrail "Stays under 6 per month" allows battery complaints to double from 3; consider a tighter threshold.
Requirements: cover location permission denied, GPS spoofing/mock locations, and customers with multiple sites or no address.
Requirements: define manager permissions (only their own team's check-ins) and what reps can see or edit about their own check-ins.
Risks: add a mitigation or fallback for geocoding API cost, not just an owner and date.
Rollout: account for support docs and enablement for reps and managers, since both will notice the change.
questions: Has legal or privacy reviewed GPS capture and 3-year retention, and in which regions will this launch?
What should happen when a rep checks in without connectivity?
Why is 3-year retention needed, and who can access historical check-ins?
